parse_xet_file_data_from_response: parse XET file metadata from an HTTP response object and return file hash and refresh route
parse_xet_connection_info_from_headers: parse XET connection info including access token, expiration, and endpoint from HTTP headers
refresh_xet_connection_info: refresh XET connection info using parsed file data and request headers to get a new access token
fetch_xet_connection_info_from_repo_info: fetch XET access token from the Hub API using repo ID, repo type, and token type
fetch_xet_connection_info_with_url: fetch XET connection info from a supplied URL with caching to avoid redundant requests
